transition.$description: Choose a transition by what changes. `feedback`, `fade`, `pulse`, and `stale` keep their timing when the reader prefers reduced motion; `movement` becomes instant. Only `stale` has a delay.

feedback.$description: Use for color, background, border, and shadow changes, such as hover, press, and the switch track.

fade.$description: Opacity when something appears or disappears: `$root` for small things, `content` for content taking the place of other content.

$root.$description: Use for opacity when something appears or disappears, such as popups, scrollbars, and backdrops. Fade content that takes the place of other content with `fade.content`.

content.$description: Use for content fading in as it takes the place of its placeholder or of other content, such as a skeleton giving way to what loaded, a crossfade between pages, or streamed text appearing letter by letter.

pulse.$description: Use for one half of a repeating opacity pulse that shows content is loading or work is going on, such as a skeleton or the label of a running step, between `opacity.visible` and `opacity.pulse`. Do not use for elements appearing or disappearing; use `fade`.

stale.$description: Use to dim content to `opacity.stale`; the delay keeps fast updates from flickering. Apply it only in the stale state, so content restores instantly.

movement.$description: Changes that move content: position, size, scale, rotation, and height. The `motion` modifier makes them instant when the reader prefers reduced motion.

popup.$description: Use for the scale or slide of popups as they open and close, such as dropdowns, menus, popovers, tooltips, and modals. Fade their opacity with `transition.fade`.

disclosure.$description: Use when content expands or collapses, for chevrons that turn with it, and for menu panels that slide in and out.

indicator.$description: Use when a selection indicator answering a click moves to a new position or size, such as a tab indicator or a switch thumb.

press.$description: Use for a control growing as it is pressed (`dimension.travel.press`), such as a button or a field under a finger. Settle it back with `movement.release`.

release.$description: Use for a pressed control settling back to its size when it is let go, without overshooting. Grow it with `movement.press`.

scroll.$description: Use for content moving inside its scroll area on its own, such as a list following its end while text streams in, an item added at the end gliding into view, or content that arrived out of view sliding in. A component following a moving target can run it as a critically damped spring that is most of the way there (about 92%) after the duration.

navigation.$description: Use for moving between places in an interface, such as a page sliding in, a view swiped aside and snapping back, or a tab indicator following the view in use, and for panes growing or shrinking as one comes or goes.

indicator.$description: Component token for the table of contents indicator following the reading position. Overshoots slightly before it settles.

drawer.$description: Component token for a drawer opening and closing, and snapping back after a swipe. Fade its backdrop with `transition.fade`.

navigationMenu.$description: Component token for the navigation menu popup moving and resizing between triggers, and for its entry scale.
